entry.title: b12101: ggml : write host-buffer tensor data directly in gguf writer (#31144)
entry.summary: The gguf writer staged each tensor into a temporary vector before writing it. For host-buffer tensors the data pointer is directly writable, so skip the staging copy and write it straight to the file. This avoids the per-tensor allocation, zero-init and memcpy. Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Visi
